verification_report.summary: The statement is self-contained, and the proof correctly establishes both implications. In the forward direction, bipartite part membership alternates along every cycle, excluding odd cycles. In the converse direction, each connected component is given a spanning tree, vertices are partitioned by parity of tree depth, and any edge joining equal-parity vertices would create an odd cycle. The componentwise partitions therefore combine into a valid bipartition of G. No external references or fact_id citations occur, and no critical errors, gaps, or hard-prohibition violations were found.
